changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Keep existing plans on strict release governance while new planning-policy rows default to key-and-measure standard coverage with blocking quality evidence.
changeSet.sql: update modeling_warehouse_plan_policy set standard_coverage = 'ALL_FIELDS', quality_gate = 'BLOCKING' where standard_coverage is null or quality_gate is null;

rollback.sql: alter table modeling_warehouse_plan_policy drop constraint ck_warehouse_plan_quality_gate; alter table modeling_warehouse_plan_policy drop constraint ck_warehouse_plan_standard_coverage;
